ask_intro: Ask anything about scholarships, apprenticeships, training centres, courses, exams or careers. Answers come only from Raah's verified data, with the source for every fact.
ask_ex1: Which scholarship helps an OBC girl with hostel costs?
ask_ex2: Which railway apprentice trades are open in Pune, and what is the stipend?
ask_ex3: What documents do I need for NMMS?
ask_offline: Asking needs the internet. Your saved pages still work offline.
ask_note_no_ai: The AI is not running right now, so these are the matching rows from the data.
ask_note_ungrounded: The AI's answer had a figure that is not in the data, so the data rows are shown instead.
q_name: Hi! I'm Raah. I will help you choose a career. What is your name?
q_name_hint: Write your first name, for example: Priya.
q_age: How old are you? Write your age in years.
q_age_err: Please write your age as a number between 10 and 30, for example 15.
q_gender: Are you a girl or a boy?
q_gender_hint: We ask because some scholarships are only for girls.
q_class: Which class (standard) are you studying in right now?
q_class_hint: If it is the holidays, pick the class you are going into next.
q_interests: What do you enjoy doing? Tap everything that fits you.
q_interests_hint: For example: helping people, fixing machines, farming, drawing. You can also say it in your own words.
q_marks_exam: Which exam result can you tell us? Pick your last full-year exam.
q_marks_exam_hint: Not a unit test or class test. Pick the final exam at the end of the school year, or your board exam (SSC / HSC).
q_marks: In the {exam}, how many marks did you get, out of how many total marks?
q_marks_hint: Write it like 412/500 (marks you got / total marks). If you only know the percentage, write it like 82%. Your marksheet shows both.
q_marks_err_unclear: I could not read that. Write two numbers like 412/500, or a percentage like 82%.
q_marks_err_need_total: Out of how many? Write both numbers, like {n}/500. If {n} is your percentage, write {n}%.
q_marks_err_small_total: A total of {total} marks looks like a unit test or one subject. Please tell us the full-year exam result, where the total is usually 500 or more, or write your percentage like 82%.
q_marks_err_pct: A percentage must be between 0 and 100, for example 82%.
q_taluka: Which taluka is your home in?
q_taluka_hint: Tap your taluka below, or type its name if it is not there. A taluka is the block your village belongs to, for example Junnar or Ambegaon. It helps us find colleges and centres near you.
q_category: What is your caste category? It is written on your caste certificate.
q_category_hint: Scholarships depend on this. If you are not sure, ask your parents. If you have no caste certificate, pick General for now; you can change it later in My details.
q_income: How much does your whole family earn in one year? Add up everyone's income. A rough guess is fine.
q_income_hint: If you have an income certificate, use the amount written on it. Many scholarships have an income limit.
q_commute: How far can you travel from home every day to a college or training centre? Count one way.
q_commute_hint: Tap one, or type any number of km, for example 42. 10 km is about 20 to 30 minutes by bus.
q_km_err: Please write the distance as a number of km, for example 42 (up to 200).
careers_source_title: Where do these careers come from?
careers_source: Every career is a row in this app's Excel dataset (sheet Careers_Income, with interest tags in Career_Profile). Pay comes from live NAPS apprenticeship listings, DGT stipend rates, 7th Pay Commission and Agnipath tables, and PLFS 2025 earnings (MoSPI); each row lists its source links. Ranking: interest match counts most (60%), then your class, what it costs your family and local demand; careers that match your interest always come before ones that do not.
ai_fallback_note: The AI chat could not answer, so I switched to quick questions.
q_hostel: If the college is far away, can you stay in a hostel there?
q_hostel_hint: Say yes only if your family agrees.
q_documents: Which of these papers do you already have at home? Tap all that you have.
q_documents_hint: Don't worry if you have none. Raah will tell you where to get each one.
q_pick_one: Please tap one of the answers below.
q_taluka_not_listed: Noted: {taluka}. It is not on our map yet, so distances to centres may be missing.
q_age_check: You said you are {age} years old and in Class {class}. Most Class {class} students are {min} to {max} years old. Is that right?
q_age_check_hint: It is fine if you missed a year or started late. Just check that the age and class are typed correctly.
